-   IMD: Index of Multiple Deprivation
-   LAD: Local Authority District
-   LSOA: Lower layer Super Output Area

# Estimated parameters

For each subtype circulating in a season:

- Transmission rate $\beta$ (1 value
- Susceptibility by broader age groups (3 values: 0-17, 18-64, 65+)
- Logarithm of total number of initially infected individuals (1 value)
- Reporting rate for primary care by broader age group and risk group
(6 values: 0-17 \& low risk, 18-64 \& low risk, 65+ \& low risk, 0-17 \& high risk, 18-64 \& high risk, 65+ \& high risk)
- Relative reporting rate for primary care by IMD quintile (2 values)

- Reporting rate for secondary care by broader age group and risk group
(6 values: 0-17 \& low risk, 18-64 \& low risk, 65+ \& low risk, 0-17 \& high risk, 18-64 \& high risk, 65+ \& high risk)
- Relative reporting rate for secondary care by IMD quintile (2 values)


# Estimating parameters from simulated data

## Scenario 1: Estimating transmission rate $\beta$

### 2023/2024

```{r}
#| label: results_1_1_a
#| echo: false
#| include: false

test_output <- readRDS(file = paste0(Dir_Local, "/output/data/", "output_1795104228905.rds"))[[1]]
test_parameters <- readRDS(file = paste0(Dir_Local, "/output/data/", "parameters_1795104228905.rds"))

test_samples <- as_tibble(getSample(test_output, start = 2))
test_mean_01 <- mean(test_samples %>% pull(1))
test_mean_02 <- mean(test_samples %>% pull(2))
test_credible_intervals <- getCredibleIntervals(test_samples, quantiles = c(0.025, 0.975))

test_true_values <- unknown_pars$epid_parameters %>%
  filter(year == 2023) %>%
  pull(transmissibility)

test_coverage <- tibble(low = round(test_credible_intervals[1,], 5),
                        high = round(test_credible_intervals[2,], 5),
                        estimate = round(c(test_mean_01, test_mean_02), 5),
                        true_value = round(test_true_values, 5)) %>%
  mutate(coverage = low <= true_value & true_value <= high)

```

#### Summary

```{r}
#| label: results_1_1_b
#| echo: false

summary(test_output)

```

#### Trace Plot

```{r}
#| label: results_1_1_c
#| echo: false

tracePlot(test_output, start = 2)

```

#### Gelman Diagnostics

```{r}
#| label: results_1_1_d
#| echo: false

gelmanDiagnostics(test_output)

```

#### 95\% credible interval

```{r}
#| label: results_1_1_e
#| echo: false

datatable(test_coverage)

```

## Scenario 2: Estimating transmission rate $\beta$ and number of initially infected individuals

### 2023/2024

```{r}
#| label: results_2_1_a
#| echo: false
#| include: false

test_output <- readRDS(file = paste0(Dir_Local, "/output/data/", "output_1795101051723.rds"))[[1]]
test_parameters <- readRDS(file = paste0(Dir_Local, "/output/data/", "parameters_1795101051723.rds"))

test_samples <- as_tibble(getSample(test_output, start = 2))
test_mean_01 <- mean(test_samples %>% pull(1))
test_mean_02 <- 10^mean(test_samples %>% pull(2))
test_mean_03 <- mean(test_samples %>% pull(3))
test_mean_04 <- 10^mean(test_samples %>% pull(4))
test_credible_intervals <- getCredibleIntervals(test_samples, quantiles = c(0.025, 0.975))
test_credible_intervals[,2] <- 10^test_credible_intervals[,2]
test_credible_intervals[,4] <- 10^test_credible_intervals[,4]

test_true_values_trans <- unknown_pars$epid_parameters %>%
  filter(year == 2023) %>%
  pull(transmissibility)

test_true_values_init_infected <- unknown_pars$epid_parameters %>%
  filter(year == 2023) %>%
  pull(init_infected)

test_coverage <- tibble(low = round(test_credible_intervals[1,], 5),
                        high = round(test_credible_intervals[2,], 5),
                        estimate = round(c(test_mean_01, test_mean_02, test_mean_03, test_mean_04), 5),
                        true_value = round(c(test_true_values_trans[1], test_true_values_init_infected[1],
                                             test_true_values_trans[2], test_true_values_init_infected[2]), 5)) %>%
  mutate(coverage = low <= true_value & true_value <= high)

```

## Scenario 3: Estimating transmission rate $\beta$, susceptibility by broader age group, and number of initially infected individuals

### 2023/2024

```{r}
#| label: results_3_1_a
#| echo: false
#| include: false

test_output <- readRDS(file = paste0(Dir_Local, "/output/data/", "output_1795101337919.rds"))[[1]]
test_parameters <- readRDS(file = paste0(Dir_Local, "/output/data/", "parameters_1795101337919.rds"))

test_samples <- as_tibble(getSample(test_output, start = 2))
test_mean_01 <- mean(test_samples %>% pull(1))
test_mean_02 <- mean(test_samples %>% pull(2))
test_mean_03 <- mean(test_samples %>% pull(3))
test_mean_04 <- mean(test_samples %>% pull(4))
test_mean_05 <- 10^mean(test_samples %>% pull(5))
test_mean_06 <- mean(test_samples %>% pull(6))
test_mean_07 <- mean(test_samples %>% pull(7))
test_mean_08 <- mean(test_samples %>% pull(8))
test_mean_09 <- mean(test_samples %>% pull(9))
test_mean_10 <- 10^mean(test_samples %>% pull(10))
test_credible_intervals <- getCredibleIntervals(test_samples, quantiles = c(0.025, 0.975))
test_credible_intervals[,5] <- 10^test_credible_intervals[,5]
test_credible_intervals[,10] <- 10^test_credible_intervals[,10]

test_true_values_trans <- unknown_pars$epid_parameters %>%
  filter(year == 2023) %>%
  pull(transmissibility)

test_true_values_children_susc <- unknown_pars$epid_parameters %>%
  filter(year == 2023) %>%
  pull(children_susceptibility)

test_true_values_adults_susc <- unknown_pars$epid_parameters %>%
  filter(year == 2023) %>%
  pull(adults_susceptibility)

test_true_values_older_adults_susc <- unknown_pars$epid_parameters %>%
  filter(year == 2023) %>%
  pull(older_adults_susceptibility)

test_true_values_init_infected <- unknown_pars$epid_parameters %>%
  filter(year == 2023) %>%
  pull(init_infected)

test_coverage <- tibble(low = round(test_credible_intervals[1,], 5),
                        high = round(test_credible_intervals[2,], 5),
                        estimate = round(c(test_mean_01, test_mean_02, test_mean_03, test_mean_04, test_mean_05,
                                           test_mean_06, test_mean_07, test_mean_08, test_mean_09, test_mean_10), 5),
                        true_value = round(c(test_true_values_trans[1], test_true_values_children_susc[1],
                                             test_true_values_adults_susc[1], test_true_values_older_adults_susc[1],
                                             test_true_values_init_infected[1],
                                             test_true_values_trans[2], test_true_values_children_susc[2],
                                             test_true_values_adults_susc[2], test_true_values_older_adults_susc[2],
                                             test_true_values_init_infected[2]), 5)) %>%
  mutate(coverage = low <= true_value & true_value <= high)

```

#### Summary

```{r}
#| label: results_3_1_b
#| echo: false

```
